jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Exploration Geologist
jobs.description:
Job Title: 

Exploration Geologist

Salary:
$120,000 - $140,000

Location:

Hawthorne, Nevada (candidates open to relocation are encouraged to apply)

The Client:

Our client is a Nevada-focused gold mining company working to bring their Mine into production as a low-cost, high-margin operation. The company runs a lean, hands-on site where engineers take on broad responsibilities and play a direct role in shaping mine performance and growth.

What you will achieve in this role:
Collect, manage, and interpret geological and assay data to define mineralized zones and future drill targets
Oversee exploration drilling programs to ensure accurate targeting and sample quality
Lead QA/QC processes for sampling, logging, and data validation
Coordinate closely with engineering and site teams to support exploration and development plans
Use survey equipment to set up and record drill collar locations
Supervise core handling, core library organization, and sample storage
Guide and monitor the work of core and onsite lab technicians
Conduct field mapping and surface sampling, documenting key geological features
Maintain high safety and housekeeping standards in line with mining regulations

What you must bring to this role:
Bachelor’s degree in Geology or a related discipline
At least 3 years of experience in exploration or mining, ideally in gold
Strong working knowledge of geological modelling, GIS, and database systems
Experience with surveying and assay sample preparation
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment
FAA drone license or willingness to obtain one
Resource modelling experience considered an asset
Demonstrated commitment to safety and environmental best practices
Valid driver’s license and ability to work in a physically demanding site environment

Only those who are qualified will be contacted.

This posting is for an existing vacancy and is intended to fill a current open position.

We use AI technology as part of our application review process to assist in screening and assessment.
All applications are also reviewed by our recruitment team.

jobs.title: Data Analyst III
jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization supports the U.S. Census Bureau’s Decennial Budget Integration Tool (DBiT) through a specialized government contract. It operates in the government services sector, providing data analytics, business intelligence, and database management solutions that support the decennial census process. Its work focuses on modernizing critical systems, maintaining operational continuity, and supporting large-scale federal programs.
About the Opportunity
The Data Analyst III
supports the DBiT contract by applying expertise in data modeling, business intelligence, and database operations. This role produces reports and analytics, supports data platform migrations, and collaborates with stakeholders to ensure data models effectively meet business requirements.
The position contributes to the modernization and reliability of critical census data systems while supporting Agile development and change management practices.
Responsibilities
• Produce business intelligence reports and analytics to support operational objectives.
• Conduct end-to-end data modeling beyond the Cognos framework.
• Support Oracle database schemas, views, and functions while assisting with migration to PostgreSQL.
• Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders to design, refine, and validate data models.
• Implement data model changes through established change management processes.
• Document business requirements, processes, and related technical information in Confluence.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
• Prepare and maintain project documentation, status updates, and other required deliverables.
• Maintain regular attendance and perform other duties as assigned.
Requirements
• Eligibility for a Public Trust position in accordance with Department of Commerce and OPM requirements.
• U.S. work authorization required.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in data analytics, advanced data modeling, and business intelligence.
• Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies within government CI/CD environments.
• Experience producing status reports, staffing plans, risk communications, and other project documentation.
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• Annual salary range: $120,000–$140,000
.
Benefits & Perks
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and AD&D insurance.
• Short-term and long-term disability insurance.
• 401(k) savings plan.
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
• Vacation and paid personal time.
• 11 paid federal holidays.
• Leave of absence benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization operates in the digital analytics and technology consulting industry, helping businesses transform raw data into actionable insights that improve digital experiences and business decisions. The company supports clients by developing measurement strategies, implementing analytics frameworks, and integrating AI-enabled tools across marketing, product, UX, and engineering functions.
About the Opportunity
The Senior Data Analyst
bridges strategic client advisory with technical analytics execution to drive data-informed decision-making. This role designs and implements analytics frameworks, interprets complex datasets, and leads analytics initiatives that support both immediate optimization and long-term transformation.
The position also contributes to AI-enabled analytics and automation initiatives, helping clients improve insight generation, operational efficiency, and overall business impact.
Responsibilities
• Audit client digital properties to validate analytics implementations and data pipeline configurations.
• Design and implement measurement frameworks aligned with business and marketing objectives.
• Advise on event-driven analytics, data layers, tagging strategies, and measurement across multiple platforms.
• Build dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics views using BI and visualization tools.
• Troubleshoot data integrity, tracking, and pipeline issues.
• Document analytics implementations and lead training sessions on best practices.
• Lead stakeholder discussions to translate business objectives into measurable analytics requirements.
• Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to develop strategic recommendations.
• Develop hypotheses related to acquisition, engagement, conversion, and other key performance indicators.
• Recommend experimentation and optimization strategies tied to business goals.
• Combine insights from multiple data sources to create clear, actionable narratives.
• Identify and implement AI-augmented analytics workflows and automation opportunities.
• Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams on AI-enabled analytics initiatives.
• Ensure analytics solutions comply with data governance, privacy, and quality standards.
• Manage analytics workstreams and mentor junior analysts.
• Support sales and marketing initiatives through thought leadership, presentations, and client-facing insights.
Requirements
• Minimum of 6 years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, or data analysis within agency or consulting environments.
• Expertise with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and enterprise analytics platforms.
• Strong understanding of digital measurement across websites, mobile applications, CRM systems, and marketing channels.
• Experience using AI-assisted analytics and automated reporting solutions.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with development and engineering teams on analytics implementations.
• Proficiency in SQL and experience working with data pipelines and cloud data platforms.
• Experience designing conversion tracking and event-based measurement strategies.
• Experience building dashboards using tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
• Strong knowledge of conversion rate optimization and experimentation analysis.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
• Ability to manage multiple projects independently while maintaining strong attention to detail.
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• Base annual salary range: $100,000–$120,000
.

jobs.title: Healthcare Business Data Analyst - Temporary
jobs.description:
Temporary Healthcare Business Data Analyst

Job Description

The Business Data Analyst facilitates business intelligence processes and procedures, development and implementation, provides query and reporting expertise, analyzes data, and assists in the presentation of insights to our key stakeholders. This position applies the strategies and implementation of data mining, analyzing, and reporting in order to facilitate the company’s ability to leverage its data in development of strategic planning and quality assurance.

This is a temporary assignment expected to run through January 2027.

Schedule:
Monday - Friday 8:30PM - 4:30PM EST

Essential Functions and Accountabilities:

Supports the design, development, and implementation of new reporting requirements. Gathers and translates business needs and requirements from non-technical end users and stakeholders into query development and design.
Fulfills ad-hoc reporting/data requests.
Performs data validation to ensure completeness and accuracy of queries and reports and reconciles discrepancies.
Assists in the evaluation and prioritization of reported issues and communicates status and resolution to relevant users.
Participates in the maintenance of existing queries and reports, re-writing and enhancing these queries as needed.
Assists in the building of data visualizations and dashboards in PowerBI to display defined KPI.
Participates in the presentation of complex concepts and results to end users and stakeholders
Participates in the migration from Tableau to PowerBI

Academic Training:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Services, or other technical or healthcare field – highly preferred
Studies level: University Education (Bachelor’s Degree)
Studies area: Computer Science/Engineering or other related field

Position Requirements/Experience:

Experience working in medical/healthcare industry - preferred
Knowledge of data collection, storage, and maintenance concepts - required
Knowledge in predictive modeling - a plus
Database organization, design, and maintenance skills.
Ability to troubleshoot database programs

Technical Skills:

Knowledge of SQL – required
Knowledge of PowerBI - required
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel (Pivot Tables/Look-Ups), Access, and OneNote – required
Knowledge of Alteryx and/or Tableau - preferred

The organization operates within the artificial intelligence research sector, focusing on advancing generative AI technologies. It manages complex, cross-functional research and training data programs that bring together research leaders, technical teams, and domain experts to support the development of innovative AI systems.
About the Opportunity
The Project Coordinator
supports AI research and operational initiatives by coordinating workflows, communications, and project activities across program leadership, research teams, and domain experts. This role helps keep projects organized and on schedule while tracking deliverables, identifying risks, and facilitating collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
Responsibilities
• Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for AI data and research projects, keeping workflows organized and on schedule.
• Collaborate with program leads and subject-matter experts to translate project requirements into clear, actionable instructions.
• Support the onboarding, coordination, and engagement of domain experts as projects expand.

• Monitor project quality, identify issues, investigate root causes, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
• Assist research and product teams in developing and refining project processes, standards, and guidelines.

• STEM educational background strongly preferred.
